answer.reason: The verses tell of Elah's death at the hands of Zimri, an event beyond what the summary states.

clauses.english: was killed by his servant Zimri, who conspired against him while he was drinking himself drunk in Tirzah
clauses.quote: Zimri went in and smote him, and killed him

doubts: The reign itself (two years in Tirzah) is already covered by the summary and offices, so it is left out.
1KI 16:13 says Elah sinned and made Israel sin, but this is a judgment rather than a deed, so it is not used.
